name: Analyze Enzyme Kinetics Assay
description: Performs in vitro enzyme kinetics assay and analyzes the dose-dependent effects of modulators.
detailed_description: Performs in vitro enzyme kinetics assay and analyzes the dose-dependent effects of modulators.
when_to_use: When you need analyze enzyme kinetics assay analysis

parameters.enzyme_name: [Required] Name of the purified enzyme being tested (str)
parameters.substrate_concentrations: [Required] List of substrate concentrations in μM for kinetic analysis (list or numpy.ndarray)
parameters.enzyme_concentration: [Required] Concentration of the enzyme in nM (float)
parameters.modulators: [Optional] Dictionary of modulators where keys are modulator names and values are lists of concentrations in μM
parameters.time_points: [Optional] Time points in minutes for time-course measurements
